svg.title: Activation A: Ask for the subtotal
svg.desc: Three snapshots: before ExecutionStarted, waiting at L2 with candidate 0 and a pending result task, then returning the new ReadSubtotal schedule. Activation A. ExecutionStarted reaches L2 and creates candidate 0 plus a pending local result task. The runner returns Schedule 0 after processing available history. The task is not persisted. Source based educational snapshots, not an executed runtime trace.
svg.text: Activation A: Ask for the subtotal
The starting event reaches the first unresolved await.
TaskCompletionSource is the helper that supplies an awaited task's result.
Core supplies serialized results. These cards show decoded example values.
public sealed class OrderFlow : TaskOrchestrator<string, string>
public override async Task<string> RunAsync(TaskOrchestrationContext context, string input)

g.text: The runner is about to read the start
No past events. IsReplaying is already false before the NEW loop.
Not entered; next source line is L1
History stays. Only the cursor moves.
Old CLR tasks are not restored
The code pointer has not entered the method. The history cursor is ready.
L1 runs. L2 creates a task and waits.
ExecutionStarted enters RunAsync. The subtotal has not been assigned.
No events left in this pass
History stays. Only the cursor moves.
Not saved for the next pass
The method yields at L2. The runner can keep processing history.
With no more available events, the unmatched candidate becomes outbound work.
No events left in this pass
History stays. Only the cursor moves.
The task itself is not saved
Not saved for the next pass
Schedule 0 requests work. The pending local task is not persisted.

svg.text: These are settled checkpoints, not a debugger capture or measured service batches.
SetResult can run the continuation before Core removes the entry from openTasks.
IDs 0 and 1 correlate durable activities. They are not .NET Task.Id or history positions.
Visited history remains. Local tasks and variable slots are not saved for the next pass.
Housekeeping records are omitted. IsReplaying describes a phase, not a permanent state.
